meta_description: Paul's Garden Maintenance in Leeds offers expert garden care, from lawn mowing to hedging and seasonal tidy-ups. Local family gardener serving Leeds. Call today.
hero_eyebrow: Local Leeds Gardener — Reliable Seasonal Care
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to regular lawn maintenance, Paul keeps your Leeds garden looking its best year-round.
services_subhead: Complete garden care — whether it's weekly mowing, seasonal clearance, or design work.

services.title: Regular Lawn Mowing
services.desc: Weekly or fortnightly grass cutting and edging, keeping your lawn healthy and neat throughout the growing season. We adjust cutting heights to suit your garden's needs.

services.title: Hedge & Shrub Trimming
services.desc: Expert pruning and shaping of hedges, bushes and ornamental shrubs. We clear away all trimmings and dispose of waste responsibly.

services.title: Spring & Autumn Tidy-Ups
services.desc: Seasonal deep cleans including bed weeding, deadheading, leaf clearance and border refreshing. Prepares your garden for the months ahead.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Rubbish Removal
services.desc: Clear overgrown patches, remove garden waste and unwanted materials. Perfect before a redesign or for neglected gardens needing a fresh start.

services.title: Patio & Driveway Cleaning
services.desc: Pressure washing to remove moss, algae and dirt build-up. Restores driveways and patios to like-new condition without damage.

services.title: Planting & Garden Design Advice
services.desc: Help choosing and planting new beds, borders and specimen plants. Paul offers practical suggestions to suit your space, budget and maintenance wishes.

about_pullquote: I started this because I love seeing a neglected garden transform into a space people actually enjoy.
about_para_1: Paul's Garden Maintenance has been serving Leeds homeowners for over 12 years. Starting with just a lawnmower and a van, Paul has built a reputation for reliable, friendly garden care across the city. He's helped transform hundreds of gardens, from quick weekly tidies to complete overhauls.
about_para_2: What sets Paul apart is his genuine care for each garden and his customers. He listens to what you want, offers honest advice, and takes pride in leaving your garden in top condition. Most customers stick with Paul for years because he's dependable, fair-priced, and always goes the extra mile.

reviews.text: Paul's been doing our garden for three years now. Always turns up on time, doesn't fuss about the weather, and the garden looks immaculate. He's cut our maintenance costs by being efficient and honest. Can't fault him.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Our garden was an absolute mess when we moved in — knee-high grass, dead shrubs everywhere. Paul cleared it all, gave us sensible advice on what to plant, and now we actually use the space. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Emma S.

reviews.text: Friendly, professional bloke. Never overcomplicates things or tries to sell you work you don't need. Just gets on with the job and your garden looks great. Highly recommended for anyone in Leeds.
reviews.author: David P.
